scope: K16/D512 base-field coefficient packing. The public workspace API, canonical opening weights, source ownership, output order and implicit suffix semantics are unchanged.
admission: Use four-bin packing only for subring128 when its positions*4 field table fits64MiB and all three pipelines admit256 threads and the actual reflected memory limit. Select before route-private allocations. Other shapes/resources use the existing coefficient gather/combine. Malformed geometry and pipeline/allocation/compute errors propagate.
algebra: Source coefficient16*r+h maps to subring coefficient4*r+(h>>2) and packing coefficienth&3. Precompute the canonical position_weight[p]*packing_weight[low] once, then each row lane adds into four canonical field bins. Sentinel255 contributes zero; selected0 contributes normally. This is distributivity of the existing packing sum, with no integer or noncanonical field accumulator.
bounds_and_ownership: Shared checked window admission bounds all selector/output accesses and enforces consecutive windows. The combined table and every tile bin are completely written before readers in the same tracked compute encoder. Rounded lanes return before access; prefix/logical-ring guards preserve odd and omitted suffixes. Output and partial buffers retain zero initialization. One batch/wait per window; first-use weight preparation is included. Failed commands do not advance prepared/window state.
measured_geometry: P65536,C39,B64,S128 uses4MiB combined weights and4.875MiB partials instead of19.5MiB partials. Output remains4.875MiB. Logical memory payloads are not measured DRAM traffic or process peaks.
evidence: Isolated same-input CI paired proof on134217720 actual/padded2^27 cycles compared all319488 output fields and passed both verifiers. Setup/readback-inclusive component .556682375s ordinary versus .139033956s four-bin; GPU .534043416s versus .117255670s. All32 windows alternate order. This is component evidence, not a full-proof throughput claim.
validation: Measured shader text is retained exactly. Existing retained_coefficient_packing_matches_cpu_onehot oracle covers S128 four-bin and S512 ordinary routes, selected0/15, absent column, tile/block/odd-prefix boundaries, empty prefix and repeated-window rejection against canonical CPU OneHotBatchView. Production normal/Metal-validation and parallel/serial Clippy remain root-run checks; no paired entrypoint or tuning selector remains.
